style: 9:16 cinematic storybook, tactile matte clay, peach-gold and teal Chinese campus residence, no text, people, mascots or simulated UI. The original HSK AI cast is composited in Remotion.

arrival.brief: A wide exterior view of the residence with an open blue door and a clear threshold.

pause.brief: A closer, quieter angle beside the blue doorway, with open floor space for the mascot.

phone.brief: A physical phone with its screen off, propped on a book on the stone bench.

return.brief: The return angle on the warm open door and path, with room for the mascot.
